rows.quote: Summary statistics from genome‐wide association studies (GWAS) for 4,907 SomaScan aptamers (measuring 4,719 proteins) from Ferkingstad et al. (2021) in 35,559 Icelanders (average age = 55±17years), and for AD GWAS from Bellenguez et al. (2022).
rows.coder_note: Sentence attributes the AD GWAS to Bellenguez et al. (2022); that author-year citation belongs to one dictionary row only.
